housing.summary: Numbeo's July 2026 Burnaby table reports CAD 2,350 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Burnaby. British Columbia caps a security deposit at half of the first month's rent: https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/housing-tenancy/residential-tenancies/starting-a-tenancy/deposits-fees. Rentals.ca provides a Burnaby-specific rental listings portal: https://rentals.ca/burnaby.

banking.summary: TD Canada Trust's official newcomer page requires one residency identification document, such as a permanent resident card, record of landing, confirmation of permanent residence, work permit or study permit, plus one personal identification document, such as a valid passport, Canadian driver's licence or Canadian government ID card: https://www.td.com/ca/en/personal-banking/solutions/new-to-canada/bank-accounts-for-newcomers. RBC's official newcomer guide also identifies proof of identity, immigration status and address as usual account-opening documents: https://www.rbcroyalbank.com/en-ca/my-money-matters/life-events/new-to-canada/banking-in-canada/newcomer-banking-guide/.
required_docs: one residency identification document: permanent resident card, record of landing, confirmation of permanent residence, work permit or study permit
one personal identification document: valid passport, Canadian driver's licence or Canadian government ID card

schools.summary: Burnaby School District offers Early French Immersion from kindergarten and Late French Immersion from Grade 6; students follow the British Columbia curriculum, with instruction delivered in French: https://burnabyschools.ca/french-immersion. The district's official elementary-school directory lists schools, addresses and French Immersion catchments: https://burnabyschools.ca/elementary-school-addresses.
curricula: British Columbia curriculum with French Immersion

legal_admin.summary: For newcomers settling as permanent residents, IRCC requires entry documents and two border screening interviews; if there are no issues, the CBSA officer signs the Confirmation of Permanent Residence and authorizes entry as a permanent resident: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/settle-canada/border-crossing.html.
legal_admin.registration_step: Present the required passport or travel document, immigrant visa if applicable, and Confirmation of Permanent Residence; complete CBSA document and goods screening so the officer can authorize entry and sign the Confirmation of Permanent Residence.

tax_finance.summary: The CRA identifies the nine-digit Social Insurance Number (SIN) as the primary newcomer identifier used for tax and benefit purposes and directs eligible newcomers to apply through Service Canada; if Service Canada cannot issue a SIN, CRA may issue a Temporary Tax Number: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/international-non-residents/individuals-leaving-entering-canada-non-residents/newcomers-canada-immigrants.html. Service Canada's application page supports first-time SIN applications and provides the required-document process: https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/sin/apply.html.

transport.summary: TransLink is Metro Vancouver's public-transport network; its adult 1-Zone Monthly Pass costs CAD 117.20 from July 1, 2026: https://www.translink.ca/transit-fares/pricing-and-fare-zones. New B.C. residents have 90 days to switch a valid foreign licence; licences from exchange jurisdictions can transfer without additional testing, while others require a knowledge and road test: https://icbc.com/driver-licensing/moving-bc/moving-from-another-country. B.C. residents must enrol in the Medical Services Plan (MSP); newcomers should apply as soon as they arrive, online, by mail or in person, and provide identity and status documents: https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/health/health-drug-coverage/msp/bc-residents/eligibility-and-enrolment/apply-for-msp.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Switch a valid foreign licence to a B.C. driver's licence within 90 days of moving. Exchange-jurisdiction licences can transfer without additional testing; other applicants must take a knowledge test and road test.
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply for British Columbia's Medical Services Plan (MSP) as soon as you arrive, online, by mail or in person, with documents supporting identity and Canadian citizenship or immigration status.
